title: MCBoard
body:
MCBoard – Seamless Server Control from Startup ⚙️
MCBoard is a powerful Minecraft plugin that auto-launches a web panel the moment your server boots up. No extra setup. No external hosting. Just clean, instant control—right from your browser. ️

Features:

    Automatic Panel Launch on server start

    User-Friendly Interface for managing players, settings, and more

    ️ Secure & Lightweight – won’t slow down your server

    ️ Zero Config Required – just install and go

    Access from any device with a browser

Whether you're tweaking configs, banning trolls, or just checking performance stats—MCBoard makes it effortless.
